notes: The main computer says when supports can't update from it: a banner appears when it has no copy of the installer to share, or its copy isn't the published one for its version (a rebuilt installer…
A Mac main computer updates Windows supports too, when it's installed from the same version's Mac kit.
Update just the main computer: support computers on Windows update themselves to match it, when nobody is checked in and nobody has used them for 5 minutes.
Your records are protected from other phones and computers on the Wi-Fi. After updating, scan the code from Setup → Connect a device once on each tablet.
Tablets can switch rooms: tap a room's name on the Room tab.
how: Shahien will send you the new installer. Install it on the main computer over the old one; your records stay as they are. Support computers on Windows with 0.23.0 or later then update themselves; older ones need this version installed by hand once.
